items.name: Ikatan Motor Indonesia (IMI)
items.notes: FIM affiliate; national governing body for motorsport in Indonesia. 2026 motorcycle regulations are published on imi.id (e.g. /regulasi-olahraga-sepeda-motor/). Seed domain imi.co.id still appears in IMI support emails; owner should confirm the long-term canonical host. Membership: MyIMI https://myimi.id (from 1 Mar 2026); Gaspol https://web.gaspol.co.id still documents KTA/KIS.
